headline: NLC, TUC end public disagreement over N70,000 workers’ allowance
summary: Nigeria's NLC and TUC have resolved their public disagreement over the N70,000 six-month transport allowance for workers, saying worker unity outweighs leadership differences.
why: The Nigeria Labour Congress and Trade Union Congress negotiate wages and allowances that affect public-sector payrolls and fiscal costs. Labour unrest can disrupt output and government budgets.
